anime_multiverse.beastwill.dragon_will.c: Sylvia's dragon will. The first stage is Static Void, which takes the holder out of the flow of time. The second is Realmheart: the eyes see mana and aether, and gravity crushes foes down. It drains mana hard and is not meant to be held for long.
Source: TBATE wiki: Beast Tamers, Arthur Leywin/Abilities
anime_multiverse.beastwill.shadow_panthe: The will of a shadow panther (AA class), as Virion holds it. The first stage borrows its speed and stealth, the second makes the holder a black panther of great strength, speed and silence. Wind and sound are bent to erase every trace of the holder.
Source: TBATE wiki: Beast Tamers, Mana Beasts
anime_multiverse.beastwill.elderwood_gua: The will of an S-class Elderwood Guardian, a giant of vine and branch with an armoured man's body on a horse of vines. It lashes, snares and thrusts great lances of vine, and mends itself fast. Tessia's was corrupted and had to be trained before it could be held.
Source: TBATE wiki: Elderwood Guardian, Beast Will
anime_multiverse.beastwill.lion_will.can: The will of a World Lion (A class), as Curtis holds it. In the first stage the holder grows a lion's mane and barely controls it. The second carries the World Howl, a huge mana blast that costs a great deal and is best loosed with the lion beside you.
Source: TBATE wiki: Curtis Glayder/Abilities, Mana Beasts
anime_multiverse.beastwill.flame_serpent: An A-class elder of the line of the Hades Serpent, the long serpent with blue flames along its spine. It senses living heat, whips with a hot tail, spits molten venom and flares fire along its spine.
Source: TBATE wiki: Mana Beasts (Hades Serpent). The elder itself is the mod's own design.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.ridge_wolf_wi: The elder of a pack of black-fanged wolves: it weighs its prey before it pounces, hunts as a pack and never loses a trail. Its fur does not mind fire (not modelled).
Source: TBATE wiki: Mana Beasts (Black-fanged Wolf). The elder itself is the mod's own design.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.wind_skimmer_: An elder raptor of the hawk line: it skims the top of the gale, buffets with its wings and, like a thunder hawk, takes prey from the ground into the sky. Storm bolts jump between its foes.
Source: TBATE wiki: Mana Beasts (Thunder Hawk). The elder itself is the mod's own design.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.ammit_will.ca: Ammit, the Devourer of the Dead: a crocodile's head, a lion's front and a hippopotamus's hind. She waits by the scales to eat the heart of the unjust. The will weighs foes with a glance, hardens like hide and ends with a bite at the heart that mends the holder.
Apophis, the serpent of chaos and enemy of Ra. The Coffin Texts give it a gaze that overwhelms Ra and his company. The will slips through dusk, lashes, stops minds with its gaze and sweeps whole crowds aside with its coil.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.cerberus_will: Cerberus, the three-headed hound of Hades, with a snake for a tail and snakes about its neck. Ovid gives it a venomous mouth. The will guards a threshold, lunges, howls with three throats and sprays venom.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.crested_boar_: A tusker like the Erymanthian boar, shaggy, wild and of vast weight with foaming jaws, and like the Calydonian boar that was sent to ravage the fields. It does not dodge: it walks through the blow, roots itself, gores and shakes the ground.
Source: Wikipedia: Erymanthian boar, Calydonian boar
The green hound of the Highlands hunts in silence and gives only three barks; whoever has not reached shelter by the third is overcome with terror. The will walks in moor mist, scents living prey, barks the third bark and marks a death omen.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.fenrir_will.c: Fenrir grew so fast that the gods bound him with the chain Gleipnir, and he bit off Tyr's hand. At Ragnarok he kills Odin. The will leaps, pounces, snaps its jaws and binds foes the way the chain bound him.
A sea creature so vast it looks like an island. It belches a bait that draws fish in, then shuts its mouth on all of them at once. The will sinks into the sea like an island, breathes its sweet bait and swallows what it drew in.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.hydra_will.ca: The Lernaean Hydra: poisonous breath and blood that kills by scent, and heads that grow back, two for each one lost. The will spits marsh venom, scabs wounds shut, strikes with many heads and regrows.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.jormungandr_w: The Midgard Serpent circles the earth and grasps its own tail; Thor's great enemy, it kills him with its venom at Ragnarok. The will slips like an eel, bites with brine venom, coils the world round foes and lets the ocean rise.
A fox spirit that shapeshifts and bewitches, with up to nine tails and kitsunebi, fox-fire. The will glamours the eye, bewilders with a glance, shows nine tails of mirage and flings fox-fire.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.kraken_will.c: The kraken: a vast sea creature said to pull down ships, whose sinking makes a whirlpool like the Maelstrom. The will clouds the water, grips with suckers, sweeps with tentacles and drags foes into a whirlpool.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.minotaur_will: Asterion, the bull-headed man of King Minos's Labyrinth, killed by Theseus with the help of a golden thread. The will senses the maze, charges like a ram, rages and shakes the maze's floor.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.nidhoggr_will: Nidhogg gnaws the roots of Yggdrasil and chews the corpses of oath-breakers in Niflheim. The will rots bark-hard, feeds on carrion, devours a foe to mend itself and gnaws roots to bind.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.nue_will.cano: The Nue of the Heike: a monkey's head, a tiger's limbs, a tanuki's body and a snake for a tail. It flies as a black cloud and cries 'hyoo hyoo' at night, and the emperor fell ill. The will cloaks in cloud, lashes with the snake tail, bites with its venom and cries a dread.
Pegasus, the white winged stallion. His hoof made the fountain Hippocrene on Mount Helicon, and Zeus had him carry his thunderbolts. The will leaps through the sky, gallops with a star mane, heals at the spring and throws a chain of bolts.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.scylla_charyb: Scylla snatches sailors with her dog heads from one side of a narrow strait; across it Charybdis swallows the sea three times a day and belches it back as whirlpools. The will snatches from the deck, lashes with six necks, devours and swallows the sea.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.sphinx_will.c: A guardian with a woman's head, a lion's body and a bird's wings, who sets a riddle and kills and eats those who fail. The will stands stone-still, stares with a riddle, stills the moment and asks the riddle of the ages.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.thunder_fang_: The chimera is a fire-breathing hybrid of lion, goat and serpent. This will is the mod's own storm variant: a ram's brace, a venomous tail and thunder that leaps from fang to fang.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.typhon_will.c: Typhon, the deadliest monster: a hundred snake heads that give off fire and every kind of noise, fire flashing from his eyes, winged, with snake coils for thighs; father of the storm winds. The will sees with storm-eyes, throws their bolts, breathes storm-fire and raises a typhoon.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.yamata_no_oro: The eight-headed, eight-tailed serpent that spans eight valleys and eight peaks, mossed over and bloody-bellied. Susanoo made it drink eightfold sake and found the sword Kusanagi in its tail. The will sees the eight valleys, lashes with eight heads and floods the valley.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.milestone.1: a quarter mastered: the will answers more readily.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.milestone.2: half mastered: its abilities recharge 5 % faster.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.milestone.3: three quarters mastered: its abilities recharge 8 % faster.
anime_multiverse.beastwill.milestone.4: fully mastered: its abilities recharge 10 % faster.
